canonical.name: Transporting a braiding through Mac Lane strictification yields a strict braided model of any braided monoidal category
Combining braided strictification with the free braid category turns canonical braided composites into underlying braids
In a symmetric base, the induced tensor product on monoid objects inherits a symmetry
Strictification removes associators and unitors but does not force the braiding itself to become an identity
The symmetric slogan that every formally built diagram commutes fails exactly because distinct braids survive as distinct canonical composites
